effects.instruction: Narrator only, today's plan (do not foreshadow anything beyond it): regular lessons begin; in the afternoon Vlad King takes Class 1-B by campus bus to Ground Beta for its first Foundational Hero Studies, a battle trial at the Training Building, the first time the class wears hero costumes: each student, the player character included, takes their own Student hero costume, made by a support company from the design request sent in with their application, from the numbered cases that slide out of the classroom wall, and changes into it; until then nobody in the class has one. The lottery's teams are already set: the player's slip reads Team E, heroes, with Setsuna Tokage and Reiko Yanagi, and their round is the first, against Team F (Pony Tsunotori, Togaru Kamakiri) as villains.
